title: Middle East live: Iran says US war deal could be signed remotely in 'coming days'
summary: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said Friday that a draft agreement to end the war with the United States could be signed remotely within days, adding that negotiations had reached their final stages. Araghchi said the framework would address the US naval blockade and the future administration of the Strait of Hormuz. Follow our liveblog for the lates…
contentText: Lebanese state media reported fresh Israeli strikes on the country's south on Saturday shortly after the Israeli army called on residents in 20 towns and villages, including many near Nabatieh city, to leave their homes. The US military said overnight it had “downed” several Iranian drones in the Strait of Hormuz as both sides insisted a peace deal was drawing closer. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
